name: OMGcon
blurb: A nonprofit pop culture festival in Owensboro with voice actors, cosplay, panels, retro and tabletop gaming; started as an anime/gaming con in Paducah in 2006.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'We can't wait to see you June 11th-13th, 2027 at the Downtown Owensboro Convention Center'

notes: No og/twitter image; used the white '2027' edition logo over the two generic stock stage/runway background photos. Guests page itself says 'Guest Announcements are coming soon to a social post near you!' so the 2027 lineup is not-yet-announced. About page confirms the con started anime/games-focused in Paducah, KY in 2006 and has broadened into general pop culture, hence types pop/anime/games.
